verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no feature showing real-time GPU stock or capacity by type and region before provisioning. The only related item is a static availability page stating CPU machines are offered in all regions. That is a catalog of where machine types are offered, not live stockout visibility, and there is no API or console capacity endpoint in evidence.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see real-time GPU availability by type and region before I try to provision, instead of discovering stockouts by failure
